fact: On 21 July 2026 a BCEAO payments official said the BCEAO is preparing a six-month PAPSS pilot with over 80 WAEMU banks, in which the central bank takes part only as an observer; the BCEAO's own PI-SPI instant payment platform, launched 30 September 2025, had 80 institutions connected by 24 June 2026.
title: BCEAO Prepares PAPSS Pilot With More Than 80 West African Banks
